mapper.select: SELECT id, name, organizer, is_kdt as "isKdt", started_at as "startedAt", ended_at as "endedAt", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM bootcamps ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, name, organizer, is_kdt as "isKdt", started_at as "startedAt", ended_at as "endedAt", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM bootcamps ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, name, organizer, is_kdt as "isKdt", started_at as "startedAt", ended_at as "endedAt", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM bootcamps WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR organizer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bootcamps WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR organizer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bootcamps WHERE ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= CURDATE()
SELECT id, name, organizer, is_kdt as "isKdt", started_at as "startedAt", ended_at as "endedAt", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM bootcamps WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, organizer, is_kdt as "isKdt", started_at as "startedAt", ended_at as "endedAt", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM bootcamps WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bootcamps (name, organizer, is_kdt, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{organizer}, #{isKdt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE bootcamps SET name = #{name}, organizer = #{organizer}, is_kdt = #{isKdt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bootcamps SET started_at = #{startedAt}, ended_at = #{endedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
